title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Newly created Declarative Agents now understand referenced scanned PDFs
description: Any newly created Declarative Agents can now reliably ground answers in scanned PDFs and image-based documents referenced from SharePoint, unlocking a major class of enterprise content that was previously hard to use in agent scenarios.
